quests.title: Spopovich Returns!
quests.summary: A huge fighter who was banned years ago is back at the tournament, glowing violet. Uub needs help.

brief.text: You're with the Patrol, right? Good. There's a fighter in the preliminaries who never signed up. A huge bald guy.
The referee says he was banned for nearly killing a girl in the ring. Now he's back, and he's glowing purple.
I saw him take a hit that should've broken his neck. He just cracked it back into place and laughed.
Why didn't you stop him?
I wanted to! But if I get disqualified, I lose the prize money, and my village needs it. You're not entered. You can go.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The World Tournament stage. The crowd has gone silent.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Videl... Where's Videl? I wasn't done with her!

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: The tournament's over for you. Get off the stage.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Master Babidi gave me power. Now this voice gives me even more! It says everyone forgot me. I'll make them remember!

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Spopovich twists his neck with a loud crack and grins.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Ugh... The voice... It stopped. It was so loud...

win.speaker: player
win.text: What voice? Who was talking to you?

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: It came from down below. From the place where they clean souls. It smelled like black water.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: It sounded small. Like a little guy. And it was so patient...

win.speaker: narrator
win.text: Spopovich drops to his knees. He won't look at anyone.

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: Ha ha ha! You're weak too! Videl! Come out and watch me!

after.text: Thank you! I'll pay you back once I win a tournament, I promise. Mr. Goku says I've got a lot of power in me. I'm still learning to use it.

quests.title: The Champ Gets Real Power!
quests.summary: Mr. Satan is suddenly as strong as he always said he was. Uub thinks the Malice did it.

brief.text: Something's wrong with Mr. Satan. This morning he challenged the whole crowd to fight him. All at once!
And he won! He flicked a grown man into the stands. Normally Mr. Satan fakes a stomachache when a fight gets scary.
So the Malice made him strong for real.
It made him as strong as he always said he was. Please go easy on him. He paid for the hospital in my village.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Ha ha ha! A challenger! Everybody saw it, I gave you the chance to run away!

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: Mr. Satan, listen to me. That glow isn't you. Something's using you.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Using me? Nonsense! For the first time ever, I'm really as strong as I say I am! It feels great!

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Here it comes! Dynamite Kick! And this time it's for real! DYNAMITE KICK!

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The kick splits the stage in two. Even Mr. Satan looks scared.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Ow! Ow, ow, ow! My back! Oh no... It's all gone, isn't it?

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Ahem! I let you win, of course! The champ has to give young fighters hope! Somebody write that down!

win.speaker: player
win.text: Sure, sure. So what did the voice promise you?

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: That I'd never have to pretend again... That was a dirty trick, kid. A real dirty trick.

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: The champ is still undefeated! And this time it's true! Ha ha ha!

after.text: He's signing autographs with an ice pack on his head. He told the reporters he was testing the rookie. I think he's okay. Thanks, {name}.

quests.title: Dabura, King of the Demon Realm!
quests.summary: A horned man in the stands has been watching Uub. He says his master is coming to take him.

brief.text: Today a man with horns was sitting in the stands. He wasn't watching the fights. He was watching me.
He said, 'You've grown since you were pink.' I've never been pink, {name}. What does that even mean?
What else did he say?
That his master would come to take me. Then he spat, and the ground turned to stone. He's waiting on the stage at sunset.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The tournament stage at sunset. Part of the floor has turned to stone.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: You're not the boy. Too bad. I was told the boy would come, and that I'd drag him down to the Demon Realm.

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: Who told you that?

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: I was in Heaven, you know. Picking flowers. Singing songs. Then this dark power rose up and woke the demon in me again.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: I am Dabura, King of the Demon Realm! You'll regret getting in my way. Now, come!

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Ugh... It's leaving me. Disgusting. And everyone in Heaven liked me so much.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Listen. There's a clan from the Makyo Star. One of them once wished to live forever.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: And Babidi wants the boy. Or what the boy used to be. That pink monster. Protect him.

win.speaker: player
win.text: But Babidi's dead!

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: So am I. And yet here I am.

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: Kneel. In the Demon Realm, the loser carries the winner's throne. I'll find you a heavy one.

after.text: Babidi... Mr. Buu hides under the table when he hears that name. I'm going to train harder. Whatever's coming, I won't let it use me.

quests.title: Uub's Hidden Past
quests.summary: Uub keeps dreaming he's a pink monster laughing while a planet explodes. Babidi is calling to him.

brief.text: {name}, this is going to sound strange. Every night I dream I'm small and pink, and I'm laughing while a planet blows up.
And there's a voice in the dream. 'Papparapa.' Over and over. When Mr. Buu heard me say it, he hid in the fridge.
If I turn bad... if I start laughing like that... stop me. Don't hold back just because I'm a kid. Promise me.
I promise. Then we'll find out who keeps saying papparapa.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The tournament stage at night. Uub is laughing, but it isn't his voice.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Hee hee hee! Uub's asleep! Uub's little! I remember being big. I remember EVERYTHING!

intro.speaker: player2
intro.text: Uub! Buu know that laugh! That bad Buu! Bad, bad, bad!

intro.speaker: enemy2
intro.text: Papparapa! This Malice is wonderful! It doesn't even need my magic. Just a past, and this boy has a great one!

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: So that's how it works. It digs up what you used to be.

intro.speaker: enemy2
intro.text: Smart, aren't you? But you have no past at all! How annoying. Uub, get rid of that one first!

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: No, no, NO! My Buu! The voice said I'd get my Buu back! It promised me the boy!

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: ...I'm me again. Just me. {name}, I think I was having his dream.

win.speaker: player2
win.text: Uub and Buu same inside! Buu help. Buu take the bad part, so Uub not have to.

win.speaker: narrator
win.text: Buu puts his hand on Uub's head. A bright pink light washes the violet away.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: It's quiet now. Really quiet. Thank you, Mr. Buu. Thank you, {name}. Now train with me. For real.

lose.speaker: enemy2
lose.text: Papparapa! Two Majins, all for me! I'm a genius!

after.text: Mr. Buu says I can borrow his power when I need it. I'll be careful. I still owe you a real fight, {name}. Come find me when you're ready.

quests.title: Android 17 Has Changed!
quests.summary: Android 17 hasn't answered his sister in days. The one time he did, he laughed. 18 wants you to check.

brief.text: I don't do favors, so think of this as a job. My brother's out on one of the islands, and he's not answering.
He picked up once. Said the island was 'finally quiet' and laughed. 17 doesn't laugh. He smirks. That's different.
How dangerous is he?
He's always dangerous. Krillin wanted to come, but I made him stay home with Marron. Just go.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The Islands. The poachers' boats are burning in the bay.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Well, well. The Patrol. Did my sister send you? How sweet. She always sends someone else.

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: She's worried about you. She said you laughed.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: I used to protect this place from poachers. Then a voice told me the poachers weren't the problem. People are. All of them.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Don't worry. I'll make this quick.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: ...Tch. Annoying. It was messing with my head, just like Gero used to.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: It came in from the shore. Purple cracks in the air, right at the water. Like it was leaking up from underneath.

win.speaker: player
win.text: Your sister's waiting for you.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Tell her I'm fine. No, wait. Tell her I said thanks. She'll hate that more.

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: You lasted longer than the poachers. Don't take that as a compliment.

after.text: He actually said thanks? ...Gross. Here's your pay. And {name}, if anyone asks, I wasn't worried.

quests.title: Raid on Dr. Gero's Lab!
quests.summary: 18 wants to break into Dr. Gero's old lab and grab the remote that can shut her and 17 down. And his gold.

brief.text: New job. Gero had a lab under the northern mountains. Bulma says there's a remote in there that can shut 17 and me down for good.
Someone's been digging around in there. Something round and white. If the Malice gets that remote, it gets us.
Then we break in and take it first.
We break in, grab it, and take the gold Gero hid behind the back wall. Call it back pay.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Dr. Gero's old laboratory. The steel door has been melted from the inside.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Intruders detected. Android 18. And an unknown fighter. No data. I will absorb you both.

intro.speaker: player2
intro.text: 19? You were scrap the last time I saw you. Who put you back together?

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: The dark power rebuilt me. It gave me more energy. It wants the remote. And it wants you to stop moving.

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: Not happening. We're taking that remote.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Energy... draining... I was only following... my new program...

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: My orders... collect the off switches of the strong... The little master wants obedient toys...

win.speaker: player2
win.text: 'Little master.' That's the second time I've heard someone say 'little'. Grab the remote, {name}. I'll get the gold.

win.speaker: narrator
win.text: 18 crushes the remote in her hand. Then she quietly pockets three gold bars.

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: Energy absorbed. The unknown fighter's energy had no taste. Nothing at all.

after.text: The remote's dust, and we split the gold. Don't look at me like that, you got the bigger half. Just don't tell Krillin.

quests.title: Into Hell for 17!
quests.summary: Android 17 was lured into Hell, where Dr. Gero built a second 17 and wants the two of them to fuse.

brief.text: 17 disappeared again. This time he left a note. 'Gone to see Dad.' 17 doesn't have a dad. He has the guy who cut him open.
Gero's in Hell. With Garlic Jr. running things down there, he's got friends. He built another 17, and he wants them to fuse.
Then we go to Hell and bring your brother back.
I'm coming with you. Don't argue. I know exactly where to hit Gero. Right in the face.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Hell. Gero's workshop is made of stolen pipes, hooked up to the Soul Cleansing Machine.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Ah, 18! You came home. And you brought the one with no past. Garlic Jr. will pay me well for that one.

intro.speaker: player2
intro.text: Cut the speech, old man. Where's my brother?

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Improved! Garlic Jr.'s Mist did what my circuits never could. It made him obey. Behold, the new 17!

intro.speaker: enemy2
intro.text: Sister. You look weak. You married a weak man. Join with me, and you won't be weak anymore.

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: ...18? Why do I have two sets of memories? One of them is from inside a lab tank.

win.speaker: player2
win.text: Because Gero built a copy of you, and you fused with it. You're fine now. You've been through worse.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: No! My masterpiece! Garlic Jr. will kill me for this!

win.speaker: player2
win.text: Not if I get to him first.

win.speaker: narrator
win.text: 18 drags her brother out of Hell by the collar. He doesn't fight it.

lose.speaker: enemy2
lose.text: Two androids and the one with no past. Gero, tell the little emperor his order is ready.

after.text: He's back on the islands acting smug. Fine. I'll train you, {name}. Don't make it weird.

quests.title: The Other Trunks
quests.summary: A swordsman in the ruins is wearing Trunks' jacket. He's Trunks, from a future even worse than his.

brief.text: You must be the new recruit. I'm Trunks. I came here from the future. It's a long story.
There's a swordsman in these ruins with my jacket and my sword. He's me, {name}. A me from a future even worse than mine.
An echo. The Kais said the Malice pulls them across time.
Then I can't fight him. I'd hesitate, and he wouldn't. Please, go. And don't listen too much to what he says about his future.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Another recruit. Where I come from, they all died in the first week.

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: Trunks says you're him. Is that true?

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: I'm what he'd be if the androids had won for one more year. I couldn't even give Gohan a proper grave.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: The voice says I can save everyone, if I stop caring who gets hurt. That's a good deal. Get ready!

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: ...My hands are shaking. They never shook when I fought. Maybe that was the problem.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Tell him not to lose Gohan. No... he already did. Tell him to keep fighting anyway.

win.speaker: narrator
win.text: The echo fades away. Only his sword is left, stuck in the road.

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: Too slow. Everyone here is too slow.

after.text: He left his sword. It's exactly like mine. I'll teach you to use it, {name}. Better you learn it from a me who still has hope.

quests.title: Gohan's Last Lesson
quests.summary: A one-armed man is glowing violet in the ruins. It's Trunks' teacher Gohan, who died years ago.

brief.text: {name}. Last night I felt a ki I haven't felt in years. It's Gohan. My Gohan. The one who trained me.
But he died years ago. The Malice must have pulled his echo out of my timeline. He's missing an arm, and he's glowing violet.
Should I go by myself?
No. I have to see him. But I don't know if I can fight him. If I freeze up, you keep going. That's what he'd tell you to do.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: City Ruins at night. It's raining. A man with one arm stands in the street.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Trunks. You've gotten tall. I'm sorry. I don't think I can stop myself from hurting you.

intro.speaker: player2
intro.text: Gohan... please. Fight it. You always told me never to give up.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: I'm trying. It found the part of me that watched everyone die. It says that part of me was right all along.

intro.speaker: enemy2
intro.text: So this time I'll do it right! No mercy for the androids! No mercy for anyone too weak to stop them!

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: Ah... I can feel the rain again. I couldn't feel anything while it had me.

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: Trunks. Don't live in the past for my sake. That's where the Malice gets you. Keep looking forward.

win.speaker: player2
win.text: But I just got you back... I don't want to lose you again.

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: I know. But you have a new partner now. Look after {name}. That's my last lesson, okay?

win.speaker: narrator
win.text: Gohan ruffles Trunks' hair with his one hand, like he used to. Then he's gone.

lose.speaker: enemy2
lose.text: Stay down, Trunks... Forgive me. I'm so sorry.

after.text: He taught me everything, and I couldn't even raise my sword. Thank you for doing what I couldn't. I'm going to train. A lot.

quests.title: Cell Hunts the Time Machine!
quests.summary: Someone left a pile of empty clothes on the road. Cell's echo is after Trunks' time machine.

brief.text: Something's after my time machine. It left a pile of empty clothes on the road. I know what that means.
Cell. Not the perfect one, his first form. In another timeline he killed me for this machine. Now his echo wants it.
And if he gets it?
He could ride the Malice to any time he wants and absorb everyone before they get strong. I'll guard the machine. You hunt him down.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Hmm. Strange. Your ki has no history. No ancestors. Nothing I recognize at all.

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: And you're Cell. You're not getting that time machine!

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: How rude. The voice promised me every timeline to feed on. I'll start with yours.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Cell's tail strikes at a group of survivors. When the dust clears, he's grown bigger.

intro.speaker: enemy2
intro.text: Ahh. Much better. Now, where were we?

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: Grr... The voice is gone. It talked like some spoiled little brat. I don't take orders from anyone!

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: I'll tell you this much. It promised me the machine if I gathered strong fighters for it. For someone who wants to live forever.

win.speaker: player
win.text: Who wants to live forever?

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: It never said. But it laughed like a child who's never been told no.

lose.speaker: enemy2
lose.text: No history at all... I wonder what I'll become once I absorb you.

after.text: The time machine's safe. I used to dream about beating him myself. Now I just feel tired. Let's both get stronger, {name}.

quests.title: Trunks' Darkest Choice
quests.summary: Trunks wants to go back in time and kill every tyrant as a child. He knows the idea isn't his own.

brief.text: {name}, just listen. Ever since I saw Gohan's echo, I keep thinking the same thing. Go back. Kill Gero before he builds the androids.
Kill Cell before he hatches. Kill Frieza as a child. It sounds so reasonable. That's how I know it isn't my idea.
Trunks... the Malice has you.
It's been in me since I met that swordsman. Meet me in the ruins tonight. If I'm glowing, don't talk. Just win.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Ruined Earth. Trunks waits on a broken overpass. His hair is gold, and his aura is violet.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: You came. I knew you would. You always do, {name}. That's why I need you out of the way.

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: You told me not to talk. So I won't.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Then I'll talk. I've figured it out. One trip back, a few graves, and every future is saved. Gohan keeps his arm. Mom keeps smiling.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Anyone who gets in the way of that future isn't my friend. They're no better than the androids!

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Ugh... I was going to kill children. I made a list. In my own handwriting.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: It kept saying 'a pure world that lasts forever, with no weak people in it.' Somebody out there really believes that.

win.speaker: player
win.text: Then we beat that somebody. Your way. With hope.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: ...Gohan would've liked you. All right. No more running. Let's save my future the right way.

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: I'm sorry. Once the timeline is fixed, I'll come back for you. You won't even remember this.

after.text: I burned the list. I'll be your master, if you'll still have me. I know what it's like when hope breaks. Let me teach you to hold on.

quests.title: Android 13 on the Glacier!
quests.summary: Every bird has fled the glacier. Android 16 says another one of Gero's androids is out on the ice.

brief.text: The birds are gone from the glacier. All of them. Even the ones that live here all year.
Another of Gero's androids is here. Android 13. He hums to himself and shoots at the seals for fun.
You're strong. Why not stop him yourself?
I do not want to fight. And part of me wants to fight too much. Please go. I will keep the chicks warm until you return.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The Glacier. A man in a trucker cap sits up on the ice.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Well, lookee here. Gero told me to kill Son Goku. This new voice says kill the one with no past. Reckon that's you, partner.

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: You're Android 13. Leave this place alone.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Quit your jawin'. 14 and 15 left me their spare parts. Real thoughtful of 'em.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: 13 takes in two glowing red chips. His body swells up, huge and blue.

intro.speaker: enemy2
intro.text: S.S. Deadly Bomber, comin' right up!

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: Aw, heck. I'm back to normal.

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: That voice wasn't Gero. It was colder. Like somebody who's been sittin' alone in the dark a real long time.

win.speaker: player
win.text: Where was it coming from?

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: Under the ice. Purple cracks in the air. Tell old 16 I'm sorry about the birds.

lose.speaker: enemy2
lose.text: Yeehaw! One less nobody! Gero'd be proud of me.

after.text: A gull came back this morning. Only one. It is enough for today. Thank you, {name}.

quests.title: The Order to Kill Goku
quests.summary: Android 16's old order to kill Son Goku has woken up. He wants you to stop him before he obeys it.

brief.text: {name}. The order Gero gave me has woken up. 'Kill Son Goku.' I have never wanted to obey it. Today, I do.
The Malice found that order and is making it stronger. It tells me about a world where I never have to choose.
What do you need me to do?
Fight me before it takes over. Do not let me reach Mount Paozu. And if I try to self-destruct, get far away. Please.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The Glacier. Android 16 stands still, with birds all over his shoulders.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Fly away, little ones. All of you. Now.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The birds fly away. Violet light leaks out of his armor.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Target: Son Goku. Obstacle: {name}. I am... sorry. Beginning attack.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: It says nature is weak. That the weak should be wiped out. But I love the weak things. I still... do.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: System clear. The order is gone. Not hidden. Gone.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: At the end, it tried to make me self-destruct. But the bomb was removed long ago. Bulma was kind to me.

win.speaker: player
win.text: So you get to stay.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Yes. I can stay. I did not know I wanted that until now.

win.speaker: narrator
win.text: The birds return, one by one.

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: Obstacle removed. Heading for Mount Paozu. Please... someone... stop me.

after.text: I will teach you, {name}. My techniques are powerful. But I will teach you to use them to protect small things.

quests.title: Turles and the Tree of Might!
quests.summary: A giant tree grew next to Muscle Tower overnight. Its fruit is purple, and a Saiyan is eating it.

brief.text: Hello. I am Hatchan. Goku calls me Eighter. Can you help me, please? A tree grew by the tower. A very big tree. In one night.
The snow is melting. The rabbits are getting thin. The tree has purple fruit. A man is eating the fruit and laughing.
Are you okay? Did he hurt you?
He called me junk. It is okay. Maybe I am a little bit junk. But the rabbits are not junk.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Another bug crawling up my tree. You know what this fruit is? Power. Pure power, sucked straight out of the planet.

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: That fruit's glowing purple. The Malice got to it.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Someone down in the dark grew it for me. Said the Tree of Might could feed his army. Fine by me. I eat first.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Turles bites into a violet fruit. His body swells, and fur bursts from his arms.

intro.speaker: enemy2
intro.text: GRAAAAAAAHHH!

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: Tch... The fruit was rotten from the start. He gave me a poisoned seed, the little rat.

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: He wanted his trees all over this planet. Make the strong stronger, let the rest starve, then take the strong for himself.

win.speaker: player
win.text: Who gave it to you?

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: He never gave his name. Just a shadow that smelled like swamp water. Now get lost, before I change my mind.

lose.speaker: enemy2
lose.text: Heh. You'll make good fertilizer for my tree.

after.text: The tree is falling down. The snow is coming back. Thank you. I will knit you a scarf. A very big one.

quests.title: Metal Cooler's Big Gete Star!
quests.summary: A metal planet is calling to Hatchan through his bolts. It wants every machine on Earth, starting with him.

brief.text: There is a new star in the sky. It is not a star. It is metal. At night, it talks to me through my bolts.
It says, 'Come home, machine. Join the Star.' I do not want to go. But last night my feet walked to the window on their own.
Then I'll destroy that star before it calls you again.
Please be careful. It says it has many bodies. And it gets stronger every time you hit it.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Outer Space. The Big Gete Star, a planet made of metal, is moving toward Earth.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Your ki has no origin. The Star cannot analyze you. Irritating.

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: You're Cooler! I thought you were destroyed.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: The Big Gete Star has a new partner now. He wants every machine on Earth. Starting with that big green android.

intro.speaker: enemy2
intro.text: Data collected. Adapting to your attacks.

intro.speaker: enemy3
intro.text: We are many. You are one. You cannot win.

win.speaker: enemy3
win.text: Systems... corrupted... no. Systems... clean? The Star is dying...

win.speaker: enemy3
win.text: I remember now. My brother's killer is still out there, and I let a voice in the dark use me like a servant. Unforgivable!

win.speaker: player
win.text: Why does he want all those machines?

win.speaker: enemy3
win.text: Bodies that never age. Soldiers that never get tired. He wants an army that lasts forever.

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: Target assimilated. Hatchan, come home. Your friend already belongs to the Star.

after.text: The voice stopped. My feet are my own again. You are a good friend, {name}. I will tell Goku.

quests.title: Dr. Wheelo Wants a Body!
quests.summary: A brain in a glass dome has been asking Hatchan about you. It wants your body for itself.

brief.text: {name}. A big robot came to the tower. On top was a glass ball with a brain inside. It was looking at me.
The brain asked about you. Where you train. What you eat. It said, 'The one with no past. I must have that body.'
Wait. He wants my body?!
He said, 'The Malice cannot take it, but I can.' I did not like that. He went to the ice.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The Glacier. A steel fortress sticks out of the ice.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: At last! My specimen! Do you know how long I've waited in this jar for a body worth having?

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: Dr. Wheelo. I've heard about you. You froze to death.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Frozen, not finished! My partner in the dark promised me the strongest body in the world. Then he admitted he couldn't touch yours.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: A body with no past, and my brain inside it! I'll be the strongest being in history!

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: My dome is cracked... My plan is ruined...

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Fine! But listen, specimen. He's afraid of you. My partner. The little one with the star. He can't read you, and it terrifies him.

win.speaker: player
win.text: Little one? What star?

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Look up at night. You'll see it. A red star that shouldn't be there.

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: Excellent! Prepare the transplant! Careful with the skull. It's mine now!

after.text: I see the red star now. I do not like it. I will stand on the tower and watch it for you, {name}.

quests.title: Goten and Trunks Take the Castle!
quests.summary: Two little masked villains have taken over the King's Castle and locked the King in a closet.

brief.text: Stop right there, citizen! Oh, you're the Patrol rookie! I'm the Great Saiyaman, defender of justice! And I need your help!
Two masked villains took over the King's Castle. They ate the whole royal banquet and locked the King in a closet!
Masked villains? How big are they?
Um... pretty small. It might be my little brother and his friend. And they might be glowing purple. Please don't tell my mom!

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The King's Castle. Two small fighters are sitting on the throne.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Hey Trunks, look! It's the Patrol! My big brother sent us a babysitter!

intro.speaker: enemy2
intro.text: Perfect. The voice said grown-ups are boring and we should be in charge of everything. Starting with this castle!

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: You two are getting off that throne. Right now.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: No way! No more bedtime, ever! Super Saiyan, go!

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Ow... Trunks, I feel weird. Like I ate too much cake... and did something really bad.

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: We locked the King in a closet. He was crying! Aw, man... my mom's gonna kill me.

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: That voice sounded like a kid, but old. Like a grandpa pretending to be a kid. It was really creepy!

lose.speaker: enemy2
lose.text: Ha! The grown-ups lose! Goten, grab the King's crown! It's ours now!

after.text: Justice is served! The boys have to wash every plate in the castle now. You were great, partner! Now strike a pose with me!

quests.title: Enter Great Saiyaman 2!
quests.summary: A second Great Saiyaman wants to fight you before she lets you be Saiyaman's partner.

brief.text: Partner, this is terrible! A second Great Saiyaman showed up! She's copying my poses... and she does them better!
She left a letter. 'Rookie: if you want to fight beside my Saiyaman, you fight me first. Castle roof. Great Saiyaman 2.'
'My Saiyaman'?
I have no idea who she is! None at all! She does sound a lot like Videl, but that's just a coincidence!

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The King's Castle. A hero in a cape and helmet lands on the wall and strikes a pose.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: I am the Great Saiyaman 2! Defender of justice! And I'm the one who sewed his cape, so watch it!

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: Videl, come on. Everyone at the Lookout knows it's you.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Shh! A hero never says the name! Look, if you're going to watch his back out there, I need to know you can take a hit.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: No Malice here. Just me. Let's go!

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Okay, okay! You're good. Really good. Fine, you can be his partner. Second partner. I'm first.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Listen, {name}. The Malice keeps going after people we care about. If it ever goes after him, you call me. Not the Kais. Me.

win.speaker: player
win.text: You've got a deal.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Good. Now help me fix this cape. I tore it up here on the roof.

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: Justice wins! Sorry! Go train some more and come back. And bring snacks. Saiyaman always forgets the snacks.

after.text: She says you passed, partner! She also told me I'm doing my third pose wrong. I'm not... am I?

quests.title: Emperor Gotenks Takes Over!
quests.summary: Gotenks went to fight the Malice by himself, got Corrupted, and crowned himself emperor.

brief.text: Partner! The boys wanted to make up for the castle, so they fused into Gotenks. Then he went off to fight the Malice all by himself!
He won! Then he lost. Now he's glowing purple and calling himself the Grand Supreme Emperor of the Universe. He took over the Time Chamber!
Is it really that bad?
He's making people pay to get in. And he keeps yelling about his Charging Ultra Buu Buu Volleyball. I don't even want to know what that is.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The Hyperbolic Time Chamber. A sign on the door says: EMPEROR GOTENKS. NO GROWN-UPS. NO BEDTIME.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Behold! The Grim Reaper of Justice, Gotenks! The voice made me even more awesome. I didn't think that was possible!

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: You know the fusion wears off in thirty minutes, right?

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Not anymore! The voice says if I let it in, I never have to split up! Gotenks forever! No more sharing a brain with a crybaby!

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Super Saiyan... THREE! Check out my awesome hair!

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Aw, man... That was so uncool of me.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: The voice said it was the littlest one in its family too. It said we were just like it...

win.speaker: narrator
win.text: Gotenks splits back into Goten and Trunks.

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: Galactic Donut! Ha! Now you can't move! Gotenks is the champion forever!

after.text: The boys are grounded until next Tuesday! Videl says I'm grounded too, for letting them fuse. Thanks, partner!

quests.title: Super Buu Returns!
quests.summary: An echo of Super Buu came out of a rift above the Lookout, still talking with the voices of the people he absorbed.

brief.text: {name}. No poses this time. Something came out of a rift above the Lookout. It's pink, and it's talking in Gotenks' voice. And mine.
It's an echo of Super Buu, from when he absorbed the boys, and then me. Garlic Jr. must have pulled it out of Hell just to get to us.
Then let's take it down.
Together. And after that, I'd like to train you. As Gohan. ...And as the Great Saiyaman. The costume helps me focus.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Kami's Lookout. Super Buu is standing on the tiles, wearing Gotenks' vest.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Hee hee! Look, it's Gohan! Gotenks says hi! He says you were too slow to save him!

intro.speaker: player2
intro.text: Leave them out of this! Those voices don't belong to you!

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: They're Buu's now. Garlic Jr. says whatever Buu eats stays eaten. Forever and ever!

intro.speaker: enemy2
intro.text: And then I ate you. Remember, Gohan? You were so strong. And so tasty!

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: Nnngh... no... Buu wants to keep them...

win.speaker: narrator
win.text: The echo falls apart. Three voices drift out of it and fade away.

win.speaker: player2
win.text: That's all it was. An old nightmare. It's over now.

win.speaker: player2
win.text: Garlic Jr. knows where we're weakest. So that's where we get stronger. Ready, partner?

lose.speaker: enemy2
lose.text: Yum! Gotenks, Gohan, and now the empty one! Garlic Jr. is gonna be so jealous!

after.text: I'll be at the castle. The King says I can train in the courtyard. He also asked me to stop posing on his balcony.

quests.title: Attack of the Cell Juniors!
quests.summary: Some little blue creatures have taken over the Cell Games Arena, and Pan wants them out.

brief.text: Hey! You're the Patrol rookie, right? I'm Pan! Grandpa Satan says this arena is his. Grandpa Goku says it's where my dad beat Cell. So it's mine!
But some little blue creeps moved in. They glow purple and keep saying 'play with us.' One of them threw a rock at my head!
Those are Cell Juniors. Cell made them here, during the Cell Games.
I don't care where they came from. I'm kicking them out! You can come too. If you can keep up!

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The Cell Games Arena. Three Cell Juniors are hopping around the ring, giggling.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Play! Play! Papa says play rough!

intro.speaker: player2
intro.text: Your papa was a big green bug, and my dad beat him! Now get out of my arena!

intro.speaker: enemy2
intro.text: Not Papa Cell. New Papa. Dark Papa. He says there's a door under the arena.

intro.speaker: enemy3
intro.text: Get the girl first! Then get the empty one!

win.speaker: enemy3
win.text: Owie... the bad feeling's gone... we just wanted to play...

win.speaker: player2
win.text: ...Okay. That's a little bit cute. Just a little.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: The door is under the ring. It goes down really, really deep. Don't go down there. Promise?

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: We won! We won! New Papa's gonna be so happy with us!

after.text: Not bad, rookie! But next time I get to do the finishing move. You're on my team now. And that's final!

quests.title: Grandpa Goku Won't Stop!
quests.summary: Goku is a kid again, and now he won't stop fighting. Pan can't calm him down on her own.

brief.text: Rookie, Grandpa Goku's acting weird. You know how the dragon balls turned him back into a kid? He thinks it's hilarious.
But yesterday he wouldn't stop sparring with me. For eleven hours! He broke my arm guard and didn't even say sorry. Grandpa ALWAYS says sorry.
Is he glowing purple?
Just a little, when he smiles. Like he never wants to stop fighting. I can't beat him by myself. Please help me.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Mount Paozu. Kid Goku is floating above the trees, glowing violet.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Hey, Pan! You brought a friend! Awesome! I was hoping somebody new would come fight me!

intro.speaker: player2
intro.text: Grandpa, stop it! You're scaring me! You haven't eaten anything in two days!

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Who cares about food? The voice says if I let it in, I can fight forever! Strong guys to fight forever, Pan!

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Super Saiyan 3! Come on, {name}! Show me what you've got!

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Whoa... ow. Huh? Pan, why are you crying?

win.speaker: player2
win.text: Because you broke my arm guard and you didn't even say sorry! Dummy!

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Oh... I'm sorry, Pan. Really. I didn't like that voice. Fighting felt wrong with it. It wasn't fun at all.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Hey, {name}, I've got one more form. Red fur and everything! Let's train sometime. The fun kind of fighting!

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: Huh? Done already? C'mon, get up! Let's go again! And again!

after.text: He ate four bowls of rice and fell asleep standing up. He's back to normal. Thanks, rookie. And don't tell anyone I cried!

quests.title: Baby Takes Over Vegeta!
quests.summary: A Tuffle parasite named Baby has taken over Vegeta, and tonight he's making a fake moon.

brief.text: Rookie, it's bad. Vegeta has white hair and a red mark on his face. He called me 'Saiyan scum.' He always does, but this time he meant it.
Bulma says there's a parasite inside him called Baby. He's a Tuffle, from the people the Saiyans wiped out. And the Malice loves all that revenge.
So Vegeta's being controlled by Baby and the Malice?
Yeah. And tonight he's making a fake moon so he can turn into a giant golden ape. We're going. I'm part Saiyan too, and I'm not scared of him!

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The Wasteland, at night. A fake moon glows over the rocks.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: The Saiyan girl, and the Patrol rookie. Your kind wiped out the Tuffles. I've waited a very long time for this.

intro.speaker: player2
intro.text: Get out of Vegeta's body! He's a jerk, but he's OUR jerk!

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: The Malice and I want the same thing. Revenge for every wrong ever done to us. And it feeds on my hatred. I have so much of it.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Look at the moon, little Saiyan. See what your blood turns you into!

win.speaker: enemy3
win.text: No... the Tuffles' revenge... I was so close...

win.speaker: narrator
win.text: Baby crawls out of Vegeta's mouth. The Malice burns away with a shriek.

win.speaker: player2
win.text: Ew! Gross, gross, gross! Okay, he's out. Vegeta, are you all right?

win.speaker: narrator
win.text: Vegeta growls something angry, then passes out.

lose.speaker: enemy3
lose.text: Saiyans bow to the Tuffles! Kneel! All of you, kneel!

after.text: Vegeta's acting like it never happened, and Bulma's acting like she believes him. And Baby's stuck in a jar now. He keeps staring at me. Creepy!

quests.title: The Shadow Dragons Awaken!
quests.summary: The dragon balls are cracking, and every selfish wish ever made is coming back as a Shadow Dragon.

brief.text: Rookie, Grandpa Goku says the dragon balls are cracking. Every wish leaves a little bad energy behind. Now that energy is turning into dragons!
And Garlic Jr. used the dragon balls once, right? He wished to live forever. Grandpa thinks the Malice is feeding on that bad energy too.
Just like the evil leaking out of the Soul Cleansing Machine.
Pretty much. Grandpa's taking on four of the Shadow Dragons. We get the rest. The One-Star Dragon is the worst. Ready?

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The Desert. Three Shadow Dragons are hovering over the dunes.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Forgive me, young warriors. I am Nuova Shenron, of the Four-Star Ball. I wish to fight you honorably, but something is twisting my pride.

intro.speaker: player2
intro.text: Then we'll knock it out of you! Honorably!

intro.speaker: enemy2
intro.text: How cute. I am Syn Shenron. I remember every selfish wish your kind ever made. Garlic Jr.'s wish was the sweetest of all.

intro.speaker: enemy2
intro.text: Once you're beaten, I'll take the other balls and become Omega Shenron! Garlic Jr. wanted a dragon of his own. He'll get one!

win.speaker: enemy3
win.text: Impossible... my minus energy... cleansed?

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: It is possible, Syn. {name} has never made a wish on us. There was nothing for us to hold onto.

win.speaker: player2
win.text: Did you hear that, rookie? You might be the only person in the universe who never made a wish! That's kind of awesome!

win.speaker: player
win.text: Well, I did just get here.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Exactly. Now go, both of you. Your Patrol is strongest when it fights for others, not for a reward.

lose.speaker: enemy3
lose.text: Minus energy never ends. Neither do wishes. Now kneel!

after.text: I'm training you now, rookie. For real! I'm Goku's granddaughter AND Mr. Satan's granddaughter. That makes me half genius, half superstar!

quests.title: The Seal Is Broken!
quests.summary: An old Kai seal holding Bojack's gang has cracked, and someone helped it crack.

brief.text: {name}, thank you for coming to the Sacred World. I need your help. My Kibito side keeps telling me I can't do everything myself.
Long ago, the Kais sealed a gang of space pirates inside a star. Bojack and his Galaxy Soldiers. The seal held for ages. Yesterday it cracked.
A seal like that doesn't crack by itself. Someone helped it. And the first one out is Zangya, the smartest of them.
Where is Zangya now?
Here. In our garden, eating the sacred fruit and laughing. I think she's waiting for you. That's what worries me.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: So you're the Patrol? Huh. I expected someone a little scarier. Cute, though.

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: Who broke the seal?

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Nobody broke it, sweetie. Someone talked to us through it. He knew all about seals. He'd broken out of one himself.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: He said, 'Make the Kais suffer, and I'll free the rest of you.' I like a man with a plan.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Ugh, my hair! Fine, you win. Don't gloat, it's not cute.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: The voice? It was small and smug, and it hated the Kais even more than we do. He called himself... no. Bojack would kill me. If he's out yet.

win.speaker: player
win.text: If he's out?

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Oh, sweetie. He's coming. The crack gets bigger every day.

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: Aw, don't cry. I'll tell Bojack you were brave. He won't care, but I'll tell him.

after.text: Someone who escaped a Kai seal of his own... Very few beings have ever done that. I need to check the old records. Thank you, {name}.

quests.title: Bojack Unbound!
quests.summary: Bojack is free and waiting by his old star for the one who freed him. That person isn't coming.

brief.text: I checked the records. Only two beings have ever escaped a Kai seal. Bojack, now, and one other. Someone scratched out his name on purpose.
Bojack is waiting at the edge of the galaxy, next to the star that held him. He's calling for the one who freed him.
Then I'll be there when nobody shows up.
Good. I'll hold the seal open behind him. You knock him out, and we'll put him back inside. Gently, if you can. Firmly, if you can't.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Outer Space. A cracked star glows violet. Bojack floats in front of it, arms crossed.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: The Kais sent their little messenger. I spent ages trapped in that star, listening to it burn. Do you know what that's like?

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: No. But that doesn't give you the right to hurt anyone.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Hah! The one who freed me knows what it's like too. He promised me the Kais would be next.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Full power! Let's see if you were worth the wait!

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Hah... You're strong. Damn the Kais. And damn you, too.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: He never came. He swore he'd meet me here. He was just using me as a distraction, the little rat. Some emperor.

win.speaker: player
win.text: Wait. Emperor?

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: That's what he calls himself. The emperor of the whole universe. Go ask your Kais who they lost track of.

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: Tell the Kais to find a new star. They'll be the ones sealed inside it next.

after.text: Bojack agreed to stay here, under guard. He's furious that his partner left him behind. I think that's the only honest feeling he has.

quests.title: Tapion and the Silent Flute
quests.summary: The Kais sealed the hero Tapion in a music box for a thousand years. Now the box is open, and his flute won't play.

brief.text: {name}, I have to confess something. Long ago, the Kais sealed a young hero named Tapion in a music box, with a monster sealed inside him.
For a thousand years. It was a terrible thing to ask of a boy. We told ourselves we had no choice. Last night the box opened, and his flute went silent.
What about the monster?
Hildegarn. Only Tapion's melody kept it asleep. Now the Malice is drowning out his song. Please, help him play again.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The City Ruins, at dusk. Tapion raises his flute, but no sound comes out.

intro.speaker: player2
intro.text: Stay back. I can't hear my song anymore. All I hear is a voice telling me to hate the Kais for what they did to me.

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: Is the voice right?

intro.speaker: player2
intro.text: ...Some days. But not today. Today I want to protect someone. Will you help me?

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Hildegarn bursts out of Tapion's shadow, burning with violet fire.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: GRAAAAAAAHHH!

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Grrraaahh...

win.speaker: narrator
win.text: The Malice leaves Hildegarn. Somewhere, a melody starts to play.

win.speaker: player2
win.text: I can hear it. My song is back. Thank you, {name}.

win.speaker: player2
win.text: Tell the Kai I forgive him. Not because he deserves it. I'm just tired of carrying this hate. The Malice feeds on it.

lose.speaker: narrator
lose.text: Hildegarn's roar drowns out Tapion's flute.

after.text: He forgave us. I don't know what to say. My Kibito side says to just say thank you and stop fidgeting. So... thank you, {name}.

quests.title: Vegito and Gogeta Clash!
quests.summary: Goku and Vegeta's fusions are over, but their Corrupted echoes are fighting on the Supreme Kai's planet.

brief.text: {name}, this one is delicate. And I know a little about fusion myself. When two people fuse, their hearts become one.
Goku and Vegeta fused to fight the overflow. Twice: once with the Potara earrings, once with the Fusion Dance. The fusions ended. Their echoes didn't.
So there are two fused Saiyan echoes out there. And they're both Corrupted?
And they're arguing about which one is stronger. On my planet. Using my mountains. Please stop them before there are no mountains left.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The Supreme Kai's World. Half the mountains are gone. Two fighters glare at each other over a huge crater.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Finally, someone to watch. I'm Vegito. The Malice took Kakarot's love of fighting and Vegeta's pride, and doubled them both. It feels great!

intro.speaker: enemy2
intro.text: Great? You're just a pair of earrings with an attitude. I'm Gogeta. I came from the Fusion Dance. That takes real commitment.

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: Hey! Are you two fighting me, or each other?

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: We'll settle that later. You first! Don't worry, this'll be quick. He's only got thirty minutes.

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: Hah... hah... The Malice is gone. And my time's up. I can feel it.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Same here. Nice work, {name}. Kakarot says you're amazing. Vegeta says you were adequate. Trust me, from him that's a compliment.

win.speaker: narrator
win.text: Two flashes of light. The echoes split apart, then fade away.

lose.speaker: enemy2
lose.text: Next! Isn't there anyone stronger in this universe?

after.text: Their echoes left their techniques behind. I'll help you learn them. And I'm sending Goku and Vegeta a bill for my mountains.

quests.title: Riot in Hell!
quests.summary: The souls waiting for the Soul Cleansing Machine have started a riot, and Cooler's soldier Sauza is leading it.

brief.text: You're the Kais' new fighter? I am Paikuhan. I keep order down here when the ogres can't. And lately, they can't.
The souls waiting for the Cleansing Machine have stopped waiting. Sauza, one of Cooler's soldiers, is leading a riot. He's skilled. And loud.
How did it start?
Two nights ago, I saw a small figure in a cloak by the machine. When I got there, it was gone. By morning, black water was leaking out of the machine.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Hell. A mob of glowing souls pushes against the ogres' barricades. Sauza is at the front.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Brothers! That machine wants to wipe us clean! Erase everything we were! I say we keep it! ALL of it!

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: You're dead, Sauza. Get back in line.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Big talk from the new kid. You can't even feel it, can you? All this evil is power now. And someone's letting it pour out.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Salza Blade! I'll cut you to pieces!

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Ugh... it's leaving me. It's going back down the pipes.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Lord Cooler is down here somewhere. If that stuff got to me, it got to him. And nobody holds a grudge like Lord Cooler.

win.speaker: player
win.text: Then we'll find him.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Find him before he finds you, rookie. And keep an eye on those pipes.

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: That's one less Patrol! Brothers, march on the machine! Nobody gets cleansed today!

after.text: Sauza has calmed down, and the line is moving again. But the machine is still leaking. Come back soon, {name}. This was only the beginning.

quests.title: Cooler's Revenge!
quests.summary: Frieza's big brother Cooler has taken over a corner of Hell, and he wants to meet you.

brief.text: Sauza was right. Cooler, Frieza's older brother, has taken over a corner of Hell. He calls it his empire.
The Malice is in him, but it doesn't control him. He's too proud to be its slave. That makes him worse.
Worse? How?
A slave fights because it has to. Cooler fights because he enjoys it. And he's heard about you. He wants to meet the one the Malice can't touch.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: So you're the one the darkness can't swallow. You look so ordinary. How disappointing.

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: And you're Frieza's brother. You sound just like him.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Don't compare me to my brother! Frieza was handed everything and lost it to a monkey. I earned everything, and lost to that same monkey.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Now let me show you a form my brother never had!

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: Hmph. The violet power is gone. A shame. It gave me such wonderful ideas.

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: It comes from deep under the machine. It has a master, child. And that master isn't as smart as he thinks he is.

win.speaker: player
win.text: How can you be so sure?

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: I was an emperor. I know when a ruler has stopped controlling his power, and it starts controlling him.

lose.speaker: enemy2
lose.text: Ordinary to the very end. Sauza, clean this up.

after.text: Cooler went back to his corner to sulk. That's the best we could hope for. You fight with everything you've got, {name}. I like that.

quests.title: Lord Slug Escapes!
quests.summary: Lord Slug escaped Hell through a rift. The Malice promised to make him young again, and he believes it.

brief.text: A prisoner escaped from Hell. Lord Slug, the old Namekian who tried to freeze the Earth and turn it into a spaceship. He climbed out through a rift.
He's very old, and he's terrified of growing older. The Malice promised to make him young. He believes it. That's the saddest kind of fool.
Are you coming with me?
Yes. A warrior of the Other World should bring back what escaped from it. And I want to see you fight up close.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The Rocky Area, at night. Lord Slug stands at the edge of a violet rift, breathing hard.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Look at my hands! They're young again! The voice keeps its promises! A little at a time, but it keeps them!

intro.speaker: player2
intro.text: Slug, it's lying to you. Nothing it gives you is free.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Of course it's not free! I find fighters for him, and he lets me live forever, like him. He's done it before. He knows how!

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: And if you won't get out of my way, I'll grow big enough to crush you!

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: My hands... they're old again. It was never real. It was all a lie.

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: He wished for it, you know. On the dragon balls, long ago. To live forever. He looked so sad when he told me. Isn't that funny?

win.speaker: player
win.text: Who wished for it?

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: A little prince from the Makyo Star. He never told me his name. He said I'd know it when the Makyo Star comes back.

lose.speaker: enemy2
lose.text: Hah! Young and strong! Tell Hell I'm never coming back!

after.text: Slug is back in Hell, old and quiet. 'A prince from the Makyo Star who wished to live forever.' I'll tell King Kai. I think the Kais already know who it is.

quests.title: Broly in the Pit of Hell!
quests.summary: Something at the bottom of Hell has been screaming one name for days, and soaking up the Malice.

brief.text: {name}. Something in the deepest pit of Hell has been screaming one word for days. 'Kakarot.' The ogres won't go near it anymore.
It's Broly. The Malice has gathered all around him, and he's been soaking it up for days. He's still getting stronger.
Did Garlic Jr.'s Black Water Mist do this?
Garlic Jr. thought he could control the Legendary Super Saiyan. Nobody controls Broly. This time, I'm fighting beside you from start to finish.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Hell, the deepest pit. The ground glows violet. Something huge is breathing in the dark.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Kakarot... Where are you, Kakarot?

intro.speaker: player2
intro.text: Kakarot isn't here, Broly. It's just us.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Then... you'll do... until he comes.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The Malice pours into Broly. His hair flashes gold, then green, then violet.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: KAKAROOOOOOT!

win.speaker: narrator
win.text: The Malice drains out of Broly. He sits down on the rocks, worn out.

win.speaker: player2
win.text: That was the hardest fight I've had in a very long time. You were incredible, {name}.

win.speaker: player2
win.text: You've earned it. I'll teach you everything I know. The Hyper Tornado, the Thunder Flash, all of it. I don't say that lightly.

win.speaker: enemy3
win.text: ...I'm... hungry...

lose.speaker: enemy3
lose.text: Not Kakarot... Who's next...?

after.text: Broly is asleep now. The ogres built a fence around him. They say it's out of respect. I say it's fear. Come train with me, {name}.

7.greet: Hey! I'm small again, but don't let that fool you. Wanna learn the Dragon Fist? You gotta punch with your whole heart!
7.done: Wow, you learned all of it! C'mon, let's get some food. I'm starving! Then round two!

8.greet: Going Super Saiyan works the same, even when I'm small! C'mon, I'll go easy on you at first. Kinda.
8.done: Ha ha! You're a natural. Pan's gonna be so jealous!

9.greet: Super Saiyan 3 burns up a lot of energy. You gotta go all out without running out. I learned that the hard way!
9.done: That's it! Just don't stay in it too long, or you'll wear yourself out in the middle of a fight. Trust me.

10.greet: This form comes from the Great Ape, so it's all instinct. Don't think so much! Just feel it and hit!
10.done: The 10x Kamehameha, huh? You're gonna give the bad guys a lot of trouble, {name}!

20.greet: Lesson one: every hero of justice needs a pose! Now, copy me! Hyah! Ha! Hoo!
20.done: You've mastered the way of the Great Saiyaman! Wear it with pride. Just don't do the poses in front of Videl.

39.greet: This sword is from a future the Androids destroyed. I'll teach you to fight to protect, not just to destroy.
39.done: You handle it better than I did at your age. Keep training. And never give up hope.

40.greet: With a sword, a Super Saiyan needs speed first and power second. Let's work on your speed.
40.done: Shining Sword Attack, perfect. Gohan would have been proud of you. I know I am.

41.greet: My mother says I train too much. She's right. But let's train anyway. Footwork first, then the Finish Buster.
41.done: You've learned everything I can teach you in this form. I'm proud of you, {name}.

42.greet: The Heat Dome Attack: let them come to you, then fly up and fire everything at once.
42.done: That's it. You've got the patience and the power. Now use them well.

43.greet: This form is all muscle and no speed. Cell taught me that the hard way. I'll teach you so you don't make my mistake.
43.done: You've got the power, and you know its limits. That's more than I did. Good work, {name}.

44.greet: Okay, I'm the teacher, so I'm the boss! First rule: if Goten says something's a good idea, it isn't.
44.done: Not bad! You're almost as cool as me. Hey, wanna go play a prank on Gohan?

45.greet: I went Super Saiyan before Goten did, you know! Watch close, 'cause I'm only doing this once. ...Okay, maybe twice.
45.done: You can do the Big Tree Cannon now?! Don't tell my dad. He'll make me train even harder.

46.greet: Hi! I'm Goten! Mom says I have to be nice when I teach you. But if I get hungry, we stop, okay?
46.done: Yay, you learned everything! Do you have any snacks? I'm so hungry!

47.greet: Going Super Saiyan is easy! You just go like this! Hnnngh! See? Now you try!
47.done: You did it! Well, kind of! Let's go tell Trunks!

48.greet: Behold, the Grim Reaper of Justice! Lesson one: be awesome! Lesson two: see lesson one!
48.done: You learned from the greatest! No need to thank me. Okay, you can thank me a little.

49.greet: Galactic Donuts! Kamikaze Ghosts! I make up a new move every five minutes. Try to keep up, rookie!
49.done: You can do the Super Ghost Kamikaze Attack! The ghosts like you. That's pretty rare!

50.greet: Super Saiyan 3! Check out the hair! Okay, focus! We split up in thirty minutes, so learn fast!
50.done: Charging Ultra Buu Buu Volleyball, mastered! I don't even know what it does! Awesome!

51.greet: I've got Goku's instincts and Vegeta's precision. I'll teach you both at once. Try to keep up.
51.done: Well done. The Goku in me wants to celebrate. The Vegeta in me won't admit he's impressed.

52.greet: The Final Kamehameha is Vegeta's Final Flash and Goku's Kamehameha in one. Let's see if you can handle it.
52.done: You've got it. Now go find someone stronger than you. If there's anyone left.

53.greet: I don't last long, so I don't waste time. Stardust Breaker. Watch, then do it. No questions.
53.done: You kept up. Not bad. Don't let it go to your head.

54.greet: Super Saiyan 4 Gogeta. Twice the power, none of the patience. Let's see if you can survive this. Ready?
54.done: Outstanding. You kept up with two Saiyans at once. I'm impressed.

55.greet: You want to learn the secrets of the World Champion? Ha ha ha! Lesson one: always look good for the cameras!
55.done: Ha ha ha! You learned everything! Not as well as me, of course. Nobody's as good as the champ!

56.greet: No flying in my lessons. Feet on the ground, fists up. And if you complain, I'll make you do Gohan's poses.
56.done: Good work! You hit harder than most of the fighters in Satan City.

57.greet: Great Saiyaman 2, ready for training! Fine, I'll do the pose. But only because it actually helps.
57.done: Justice approved! And you didn't laugh at the helmet once. Thanks for that.

61.greet: In Other World, the dead train forever. You don't have that much time. So we'll train harder.
61.done: You've learned all I know. When your time comes, and I hope it's far away, come find me. We'll fight again.

62.greet: I learned the sword to protect my people, and the flute to keep Hildegarn sealed. I'll teach you to fight with strength and a calm heart.
62.done: You've learned everything I can teach. Thank you, {name}. It's been a long time since I could share this.

63.greet: Okay, Pan's Training Camp is starting! No whining, no flying away, and you're buying the snacks after!
63.done: Done! You learned everything, even Maiden's Rage! You're my second favorite fighter. After Grandpa!

64.greet: Mr. Goku taught me to find the strength inside me. I'll teach you the same thing. Let's go!
64.done: You learned it all. I still want a real match with you, {name}. Maybe at the next tournament?

65.greet: Mr. Buu gave me his power. It's a lot to handle. Let me show you how to control it.
65.done: That's everything, {name}. Mr. Buu would say you're 'good good'!

100.greet: My techniques were made to destroy. I would like you to learn them to protect. Let us begin.
100.done: You have learned everything I know. The birds seem happy with you too.

101.greet: I'll teach you, but I'm not holding your hand. The barrier is all about timing. Get it wrong and you'll eat a Photon Flash.
101.done: Fine. You're good. Just don't tell my sister I said that.

102.greet: Let's keep this simple. No wasted moves. Every move uses energy, so make each one count.
102.done: That's it, you're done. Not bad. Now get going. Marron needs her nap.

103.greet: Lesson one. Absorb energy. ...I cannot read your energy. Strange. This will be difficult.
103.done: Training complete. You are... adequate. Dr. Gero would want data on you.

104.greet: I am Dr. Gero, genius of the Red Ribbon Army. I'll teach you, but only so I can study you.
104.done: Remarkable. You learned everything so quickly. I'd love to study you in my lab. Purely for science, of course.

105.greet: My early techniques were all taken from others. Goku, Piccolo, Frieza... Now I'll pass them on to you.
105.done: You've learned everything. Now don't stand so close. I'm still hungry, you know.

106.greet: This form has power, but no grace. I hate it. Still, it has its uses. Let's begin.
106.done: Adequate. Not perfect. Nothing is perfect at this stage. Except me, soon enough.

109.greet: Play! You want to learn? We'll teach you by playing! Playing really, really hard!
109.done: You learned all our games! Now you're our friend!

110.greet: Papparapa! Very well, I'll teach a Patrol brat some of my magic. Kneel before me! ...No? Ugh, fine.
110.done: You've learned my magic! And you're not even grateful! Nobody is ever grateful to Babidi!

111.greet: In the Demon Realm, we learn through pain. I've gone soft in Paradise, so I'll only use half as much.
111.done: Good. You'd make a fine demon. That's the best praise I know.

115.greet: Hee hee! I got all of Gotenks's moves when I absorbed him. Want to learn them? I'll teach you!
115.done: Done! You know all the Gotenks tricks now. I guess I won't eat you. For now.

116.greet: Gohan's power feels so good. Hee hee. Let me show you how strong he really was.
116.done: All done. I'm a better teacher than Gohan ever was. Hee hee.

120.greet: You will train under the greatest scientific mind on Earth. And do not touch my dome!
120.done: Fascinating. You learned every technique perfectly. I'd love a body like yours. Ha ha ha!

121.greet: I conquer planets for fun. Learning from me is a privilege. Here, eat this fruit. Trust me.
121.done: You fight like a real space pirate now. Take what you want. Just stay away from my tree.

122.greet: GRRRH! Big, strong and fast. Sometimes that's all you need in a fight. Watch my fists!
122.done: Hrrrr. Good. Now go find yourself a full moon.

123.greet: I was conquering planets long before you were born. Listen well. Experience beats youth.
123.done: You learned it all, and quickly. Youth... I wanted mine back so badly.

124.greet: Growing giant is a technique too. A big body still has to move fast. Watch my feet.
124.done: Good. Never forget how to fight when you're the small one.

125.greet: Lord Cooler's Armored Squadron trains until we bleed. I'll go easy on you. Just kidding. Draw your blade.
125.done: You've learned the Salza Blade Rush. Use it well, rookie.

126.greet: I'll teach you, if only to prove I'm a better teacher than my little brother. Frieza never taught anyone anything.
126.done: You've learned my style. Use it with pride. That's the only way it works.

127.greet: This is a form my brother never reached. Don't be afraid of the mask. Be afraid of what's under it.
127.done: Supernova, mastered. If you ever get the chance to use it on Frieza, do it.

128.greet: Training program started. Each technique will be repeated until you are perfect, or broken.
128.done: Program complete. Your results exceed all predictions. ...That is annoying.

129.greet: Hey there. Gero built me for one job: killin' Goku. Let's see if I can teach you somethin' better.
129.done: You got all of it! Not bad, partner. Not bad at all.

130.greet: With 14 and 15's parts inside me, I'm way stronger. Lesson one: try not to get flattened.
130.done: The S.S. Deadly Hammer is yours now, partner. Use it well.

131.done: ...Good. You're strong. Not Kakarot. But strong.

132.greet: Rrrgh... The power never stops. I'll show you how to hold it. Don't let go.
132.done: You held on. Most people break.

133.greet: I am the Legendary Super Saiyan! There are no techniques! Only more power!
133.done: You survived... Hmph. Now... where is Kakarot?!

134.greet: Training with me? Sure, cutie. Psycho Thread first. It's all in the wrists. Try not to get tangled.
134.done: Look at you! You learned it all. Even Bojack would be impressed.

135.greet: I learned to fight by conquering. You'll learn by bleeding. Let's see how long you last.
135.done: Hah. You'd have made a fine Galaxy Soldier. Too bad you work for the Kais.

136.greet: Full power. No holding back. This is the power the Kais were so afraid of. Are you afraid too?
136.done: Galactic Buster, mastered. Not bad. The Kais should be worried about you too.

139.greet: GRAAAAH! (Hildegarn watches you closely. When you raise your fists, it raises its claws. The lesson has begun.)
139.done: Grrrrr... (Hildegarn lowers its head and lets out a long, low rumble. It seems satisfied.)

140.greet: The Tuffles were the smartest race in the universe. I'll teach you using this Saiyan's body. How fitting.
140.done: You learned it all. The Tuffles would have been proud to have you.

141.greet: Stronger, faster, perfect. Watch my Finger Blitz Barrage. Try to count the shots.
141.done: You counted every one. Annoying, but impressive.

142.greet: With the energy of the whole Earth behind me, I'll teach you the Revenge Death Ball. Revenge makes you strong!
142.done: You've learned it all. Now you know the power of the Tuffles' revenge.

143.greet: GOLDEN... GREAT APE! I'll teach you... the Tuffles' REVENGE!
143.done: Hrrrr... good... You fight like a Tuffle now...

144.greet: Two 17s in one body. My barrier stops anything. I'll show you how. And don't go telling my sister.
144.done: Hell's Storm, mastered. You could probably beat me now. Don't try it.

145.greet: I am Nuova Shenron, the Four-Star Dragon. I fight with honor and with fire. Show me yours.
145.done: You've learned it all, and you fought with honor. I'm glad we met.

146.greet: I was born from every selfish wish ever made. I'm teaching you because it amuses me. Don't call it mercy.
146.done: Mastered. How boring. Leave, before I change my mind about you.

147.greet: I am Omega Shenron, the strongest of the Shadow Dragons. Learn from me, little Patrol member, if you can.
147.done: You survived it all. Hmph. Not even the Dragon Balls have seen a fighter like you.

158.greet: Babidi made me his puppet. Never again. I'll teach you how to keep getting back up, no matter what.
158.done: You learned it all. You're tougher than me. Now get out of here.

159.greet: Trunks says you've been looking out for him. Thank you. I can't stay long, so let's start. Masenko first.
159.done: You learned it all. I'm proud of you, {name}. Take care of the future for me.

160.greet: I fought like this for years, with only one arm. Don't feel sorry for me. Watch my balance and make every hit count.
160.done: You make every hit count now. That's all a teacher can ask for.
